title: The twisting sheaf O(1) on P^n_Z on the standard charts
statement: Let $n\ge0$, $S=\mathbf Z[T_0,\dots,T_n]$ graded by total degree, $\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj], and $\mathcal O(1)=\widetilde{S(1)}$ the quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}}$-module attached to the shifted graded module $S(1)$ (so $\mathcal O(1)(D_+(f))=S(1)_{(f)}=(S_f)_1$ for homogeneous $f$ of positive degree), with the global sections $T_0,\dots,T_n\in\Gamma(\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z},\mathcal O(1))$ given by $T_l\mapsto T_l/1\in(S_f)_1$ on every $D_+(f)$. Then: (i) $\mathcal O(1)$ is an invertible $\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}}$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]; (ii) for every $j$, $D_+(T_j)\cong\operatorname{Spec}S_{(T_j)}$ and $S_{(T_j)}=\mathbf Z[T_0/T_j,\dots,T_n/T_j]$ is the polynomial ring over $\mathbf Z$ in the $n$ elements $T_l/T_j$, $l\neq j$; (iii) $D_+(T_j)$ is the non-vanishing locus $(\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z})_{T_j}=\{x: T_{j,x}\notin\mathfrak m_x\mathcal O(1)_x\}$ of the section $T_j$; (iv) for all $j,l$, $T_l|_{D_+(T_j)}=(T_l/T_j)\cdot T_j|_{D_+(T_j)}$ in $\mathcal O(1)(D_+(T_j))$, where $T_l/T_j\in S_{(T_j)}=\Gamma(D_+(T_j),\mathcal O)$.

source.place: Constructions, Definition (Tag 01MN, label definition-twist) for O(1); Lemma (Tag 01MS, label lemma-when-invertible) for (i) on each $D_+(T_j)$ (which cover, Tag 01M4/01MA); Lemma (Tag 01MA, label lemma-standard-open-proj) for $D_+(f)\cong\operatorname{Spec}S_{(f)}$; Lemma (Tag 01MV, label lemma-principal-open, with $d=1$, $W_1=\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$ by Tag 01MU) for (iii); (iv) is the identity $T_l/1=(T_l/T_j)(T_j/1)$ in $(S_{T_j})_1$; Section (Tag 01ND, label section-projective-space) for $\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$
